events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later.

angles.name: Tribute to an icon
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation and whose impact on music is still felt today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar legend tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's innovative guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album plays
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude!

events.title: Imagine Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The message still resonates.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the iPod changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first song you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's their most iconic moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon, born on this day in 1940, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy!

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' ambitious 'White Album' dropped. What are your hidden gems from this masterpiece?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: A true game-changer! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of music icon John Lennon, who died on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace and music continues to inspire generations.
